page_topic_one_liner: Google Search Console branded vs non-branded query filter — separating brand navigation traffic from organic topic discovery for accurate SEO measurement
differentiator_vs_generic: This is GSC Performance report filtering education, NOT brand marketing creative. Hero must show Search Console with an active Branded queries / Non-branded queries filter chip and split metric bars — NOT an AI chat panel or generic analytics pie chart.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Google Search Console Performance report mockup — date-range header, active filter pill labeled 'Branded queries' with accent border, clicks/impressions/CTR metric row below, query table with blurred brand vs generic query rows split visually (left column warmer tone, right cooler)
Secondary: Insights report branded-traffic card — two horizontal bars comparing branded vs non-branded click share (no numeric labels, proportional widths only)
Tertiary: filter dropdown UI fragment showing Query > Branded / Non-branded options with one option highlighted
anti_patterns: Generic Google Analytics acquisition pie without GSC context
Brand logo wall or PR campaign imagery unrelated to query filtering

en.headline: GSC BRANDED FILTER
en.subtitle: Brand vs Non-Brand Queries
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for GSC branded query filter guide. HERO: realistic but generic Search Console Performance report occupying right two-thirds — active 'Branded queries' filter chip with titian-red accent border, metric summary row (clicks/impressions/CTR blur), query table with visually split branded vs non-branded rows. Secondary: Insights branded-traffic comparison card with two proportional bars. Tertiary: Query filter dropdown fragment. Title block top-left only. Paper torn edges, halftone. NO LLM chat UI, NO real Google logo, NO readable query strings, NO extra filter labels as body text.
